commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src conda run -n autodrift python -m autodrift.input_observability_audit --env-config configs/m91c_raw_wheel_minimum_profile.json --episodes 20 --seed 9320 --policy heuristic --horizon-steps 15 --sample-stride 4 --max-samples 400 --ridge 0.1 --run-dir runs/m91c_raw_wheel_minimum_profile_smoke_seed9320
commands.name: raw_wheel_profile_smoke

decision_rule: Pass as infrastructure only if the environment exposes a clean raw wheel-state profile separate from derived slip/ABS/TCS proxies and the smoke probe writes artifacts. Scientific promotion requires a later formal rerun.
failure_criteria: raw wheel profile cannot be enabled by config
raw wheel channels are aliases for mu, tire force limits, or feasibility labels
raw wheel profile cannot run the input observability harness
hypothesis: The weak M91-B lift is partly caused by the current proxy wheel features; a cleaner raw wheel-state profile is needed before judging wheel observability or training PPO.
success_criteria: raw wheel profile is config-gated and does not change legacy defaults
derived slip and ABS/TCS proxy features are not part of the clean profile
input observability harness runs on the clean profile
documentation states that M91-C is infrastructure, not a promoted driver
